c2.reference_agreement: Per workload, before timing: host-native, L3 and L4 agree under ≡obs on 200 input vectors (W3, W4) and on the W1 value and the W2 final state; see each workload's agreement field. Phase B: L2 (rustc_apfloat), B2-ORACLE, L3, L4 agree on all vectors (phase-b-core.json).
c2.finite_coverage: Finite only: Phase B boundary vectors, 8 seeded random graphs x 20,000 vectors, 10^6 operand pairs per operation, 2,000 gradient samples, the 35 core rejection controls; Phase C agreement samples above. No exhaustive or symbolic coverage.

theorem_obligations.statement: extraction preserves Obs on the I64 overlap
reference model corresponds to IEEE binary32
ngraph-deriv-real/0 computes the real derivative away from corners
executed compiled-graph bytes correspond to the admitted graph

trusted_boundaries: rustc/LLVM release codegen of the pinned nightly (no contraction; default x86-64 features)
host CPU IEEE binary32/64 arithmetic, no FTZ/DAZ
this crate's checker, L3, L4, trainer and the hand-written native baselines
std::time::Instant and a shared, unisolated host for timings
c2.unsupported_instrumentation: hardware performance counters, RSS/allocator peak, cache misses, energy: unsupported (not zero); byte figures are element-count estimates
c2.not_run: pinned handwired under pinned Bun (optional, informational): not run

c3.thresholds: kept at approval: stop unless compiled CPU graph ≥2× faster than both baselines on warm W3; admission ≤100 ms at W3 scale; ≥2× margin over compiled CPU before any scoped #2 GPU experiment
c3.both_baselines_interpretation: W3 is ngraph-f32/0 authored IR (B0(b)); Noble's ordinary Wasm/V8 path has no F32, so that baseline does not exist for W3. The test is applied to the one existing baseline (host-native Rust) and cannot pass on the missing one: the missing baseline never makes the outcome more favourable. The I64 workloads W1/W2, where the ordinary path exists, are reported separately and do not substitute for W3.
c3.training_value_demonstrated: B5 passed (loss ≤10% of initial on F1); W3 training cost measured
c3.gpu_experiment: blocked: no measured or explicitly modelled transfer and launch costs; and the compiled CPU graph is not the comparison point that would need a 2× GPU margin unless CPU specialization were recommended
